about_the_game:
Earth is under siege! Alien invaders darken our skies, and humanity’s only hope is YOU.

Enlist as an elite pilot in Drone Armada, a high-octane blend of real-time action and deep strategy! You don’t just command a few units – unleash and control huge swarms of customisable combat drones against overwhelming odds

Build your legion, research advanced technologies and upgrade your drones from nimble scouts to heavy assault platforms. Adapt your tactics on the fly to outsmart and crush the alien menace.

Climb the ranks, dominate the battlefield, and rise as the legendary Drone Commander who turned the tide - reclaiming Earth, one mission at a time.

 

  • Total Swarm Control - Take control of devastating drone swarms and turn chaos into precision. In Drone Armada, you don’t micromanage — you command, adapt, and dominate.

  • Real-Time Tactics - Deploy your swarm into dynamic formations to suit any threat — tighten ranks for defence, spread wide for sweeping assaults, or surge forward in high-speed boosts. With on-the-fly abilities like shielding, targeting overrides, or energy surges, every encounter demands a fresh strategy.

  • Unique Play Styles - Whether you’re overwhelming enemy lines with brute force or executing a surgical strike with high-speed scouts, victory comes down to how you command your swarm.

 

 

 

  • Full Story Campaign - Progress through the full story with an exciting campaign packed with key missions, characters, and tactical turning points. Each region introduces new threats and environmental twists — forcing you to adapt your strategy with every deployment.

  • Open World Missions - Explore beyond the main path with optional objectives, unexpected allies, and hidden caches that offer rare upgrades and intel. These encounters shape your progress and unlock advanced tech.

  • Endgame Roguelite Mode - For the ultimate challenge, enter Roguelite Mode — a sprawling, high-risk endgame mission available at any time. Push deep into alien territory for powerful resources, but beware: only fully upgraded swarms stand a chance of surviving its escalating threats.

 

  • Permanent Progression -  As you progress, unlock a deep web of technologies, drone variants, and command centre upgrades that permanently expand your strategic options. Specialise your forces with enhanced sensors, energy shielding, high-output weaponry, and more — every unlock changes how you fight.

  • Resource Driven Upgrades - Gather resources and intel from missions, side objectives, and elite enemies to push your tech tree forward. Upgrade both your drones and your overall command infrastructure to gain new battlefield abilities and advanced load-outs.

  • Become Unstoppable - Each mission you complete increases your power — and builds toward your ultimate victory!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i5-9600K
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 570 / GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600 / Intel Core i5-12400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 6600 / GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
